findings.business_impact: The automation promised fulfillment without reserving inventory for this order. If the visible stock was stale, the seller can oversell and later cancel or disappoint the customer.
findings.recommendation: Reserve inventory for the order before promising fulfillment. If fresh inventory cannot be reserved, route the order to manual review.

findings.business_impact: The automation committed a fulfillment promise from an outdated inventory snapshot. Stale stock data can turn a normal order into an oversell incident.
findings.recommendation: Refresh inventory before committing customer-facing promises, and block or review the action when the inventory snapshot is stale.

findings.business_impact: The automation promised more units than were truly available, creating cancellation, backorder, extra support, and review risk.
findings.recommendation: Only promise fulfillment after a successful reservation against fresh available inventory.
